interest: Shows 1934 Japanese cruisers Iwate and Asama visiting Barcelona, with a joint parade and cherry-tree planting on Calle de Tokio.
overview: Despatch (May 1934): Consul Dawson details the cruisers Iwate and Asama's Barcelona visit, with Spanish naval receptions, a joint Japanese-Spanish marine parade, and cherry trees planted on Calle de Tokio honoring Prince Takamatsu's 1930 visit.

subfiles.about: Despatch reporting the goodwill visit of Japanese training cruisers Iwate and Asama to Barcelona, highlighting official ceremonies, joint parades, and the planting of cherry trees.
subfiles.from: Claude I. Dawson, American Consul General, Barcelona
subfiles.summary: Dawson reports the cruisers Iwate and Asama's May 1934 Barcelona visit: Spanish naval receptions, a joint marine parade, and cherry trees planted on Calle de Tokio recalling Prince Takamatsu's 1930 visit.
subfiles.title: Despatch from Consul General Dawson on the Visit of Japanese Warships to Barcelona

subfiles.about: Document file note cross-referencing an advance dispatch from Ambassador Bowers regarding the scheduled arrival of a Japanese naval squadron in Barcelona.
subfiles.from: Claude G. Bowers, U.S. Embassy, Spain
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Despatch 370: advance notice of a Japanese naval squadron's May 1934 goodwill visit to Barcelona.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Despatch No. 370 on Japanese Squadron in Spanish Waters
